title: Capacity before scaling
symptoms: CPU throttling memory OOM latency resource saturation capacity traffic concurrency autoscaler
checks: Compare request rate, p95 latency and CPU throttling over the same five-minute window.
Inspect memory limits and recent OOM kills before increasing replicas.
Check whether downstream capacity can support more workers.
action: If load is the cause, increase capacity gradually and watch downstream error rates. If memory rises without traffic, investigate the allocation change first.

title: Contain a release regression
symptoms: deployment rollout release regression image canary configuration readiness crash errors
checks: Compare errors between the current and previous revision.
Check release notes, configuration changes and readiness probe failures.
Confirm that the previous revision is compatible with current data.
action: Pause the rollout. Propose a rollback only after checking data compatibility; have the incident lead approve it.

title: Trace the database bottleneck
symptoms: MongoDB DynamoDB query connection pool replication index database timeout read write throttle partition
checks: Separate connection wait time from query execution time.
Inspect slow query plans, index coverage and hot partitions.
Check primary health and replication lag before changing read preferences.
action: Capture the offending query or partition key. Propose an index or capacity change using the evidence; do not restart the database as a first step.

title: Follow the failing hop
symptoms: DNS TLS certificate handshake connection timeout network route upstream proxy gateway packet loss
checks: Resolve the dependency hostname from the affected workload.
Inspect certificate validity and the full trust chain.
Compare connectivity from the workload and a known healthy peer.
action: Identify the first failing hop, then propose the smallest DNS, certificate or routing correction. Verify from the affected workload.

title: Recover a stalled consumer
symptoms: SQS Celery EventBridge Redis queue backlog message oldest consumer worker broker visibility redelivery dead letter
checks: Compare arrival rate, consumer throughput and oldest-message age.
Inspect worker logs and dead-letter samples without logging payload secrets.
Check target permissions and visibility timeout against processing duration.
action: Restore the consumer or target permission first. Replay a small dead-letter sample after the cause is fixed, preserving event IDs.

title: Verify identity and permissions
symptoms: IAM OAuth JWT token issuer authentication authorization credentials access denied forbidden 401 403 secret
checks: Distinguish expired or invalid identity (401) from denied permission (403).
Check issuer, audience, signing key rotation and credential expiry.
Inspect the effective IAM policy and resource scope for the failing principal.
action: Correct the specific credential or policy scope. Avoid granting broad wildcard permissions to clear the error.
